name: Caffeinated Energy Drinks (Monster, Red Bull, Celsius — Extreme Motility Hazard)
whyItWorks: A catastrophic trigger cocktail for IBD: massive doses of anhydrous caffeine (160–300mg), taurine, carbonation, and artificial sweeteners or citric acid. Caffeine strongly stimulates colonic peristalsis, triggering uncontrollable watery diarrhea, severe mucosal burning, and rectal bleeding.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Medical Warning: Never consume energy drinks if you have Crohn's disease or Ulcerative Colitis. If needing a gentle morning lift, choose warm black tea or decaf coffee in deep remission.
watchOuts: Extreme gut motility stimulant: Causes violent cramping, immediate fecal urgency, and dehydrating diarrhea.
